issues.description: Return type mismatch for Farm.singFarmSong(): The problem statement's UML and textual description require singFarmSong() to print the song (void) and the template declares public void singFarmSong(), but the solution implements public String singFarmSong() returning the song text. This inconsistency can confuse students about whether to print or return the song and may cause grader/test incompatibilities.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution to keep singFarmSong() void and print the song (matching the UML and template), or update the problem statement and template to specify and declare singFarmSong() as returning String. Preferably align to the problem statement (void) and update the solution to print the song to avoid surprising students.

issues.description: Return type mismatch for Farm.singFarmSongVerse(Animal): The UML in the problem statement specifies singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal):void and the template defines a private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/), but the solution implements a private String singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) returning the verse text. This inconsistency about printing vs. returning the verse can mislead students when implementing the helper method.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method signature/behavior across artifacts. Either have singFarmSongVerse(...) remain void and print lines directly (update solution accordingly), or change the problem statement and template to expect a String-returning helper and document that singFarmSong() should concatenate and return the full song. Prefer making the solution match the problem statement (void helper that prints) to avoid changing the specified UML.
